name: Chinatichampsus
sum: Caimanine alligatorid from the middle Eocene Devil's Graveyard Formation of Texas, known from one skull.
wsnote: The specimen was probably mature; the sources give no measurements.
holotype: TMM 45911-1 — skull without the lower jaw and most of the left upper surface, Devil's Graveyard Formation, Texas (42.8–41.5 Ma).
biology: The sources say nothing about its biology.
author: Stocker et al. 2021
